osaka_awa_sushi_minamisenba.gf_detail: Not gluten-free: soy sauce on the sushi; simmered and fried dishes; dobin-mushi dashi. Tell the restaurant when booking and ask.
osaka_awa_sushi_minamisenba.vegan_detail: Not vegan: a fish and shellfish omakase.
osaka_awa_sushi_minamisenba.hours_raw: Daily 17:00–22:30, last entry 20:30, all guests start together; lunch for private bookings only (Tabelog). Reservation only (May 2026). Cards, transit IC, iD and QR (PayPay, Alipay, WeChat Pay) accepted; no service charge (Tabelog).
osaka_awa_sushi_minamisenba.notes: [Sushi · sushi omakase with a champagne pairing, Minami-Senba] A sophisticated ten-seat sushi counter inside a champagne-themed hotel near Nagahoribashi, built around one idea: sushi with champagne. The omakase runs to small dishes and about a dozen nigiri, with standouts like abalone steamed for six hours in its liver sauce (mixed with a little sushi rice at the end), sweet uni, medium-fatty tuna and anago with a rich sauce. The pairing pours a glass every two or three courses from a list of over 200 champagnes, with a featured house each month, and staff guide non-experts well. Dinner only, all guests start together; reserve for an anniversary night. One diner found a grilled fish watery.

chef_bio.background: Sushi counter in Cuvée J2 Hôtel Osaka (Tabelog; 2026 reviews).

anecdotes.text: "What stood out the most was the abalone that had been steamed for 6 hours. It was astonishingly tender, and when dipped in the liver sauce, the umami flavor burst forth…" — April 2026, Awa Sushi Omakase Course.
"I requested the champagne pairing, enjoying one glass with every two to three dishes, totaling five glasses." — April 2026.

osaka_furatto_curry_ya_inari.gf_detail: Not gluten-free: European-style roux curry; breaded chicken katsu.
osaka_furatto_curry_ya_inari.vegan_detail: Not vegan: chicken katsu; the curry base is not described — ask.
osaka_furatto_curry_ya_inari.hours_raw: Mon, Thu, Fri, Sat 11:30–21:00; Tue–Wed 11:30–17:00 (last order 16:00); closed Sun and public holidays; evenings end when the rice runs out (Tabelog). No cards; PayPay and d Barai accepted (Tabelog). Smoking allowed (Tabelog). Hot inside in summer (July 2026).
osaka_furatto_curry_ya_inari.notes: [Curry · a ¥980 chicken katsu curry behind JR Namba, Inari] A small, warm curry shop on a quiet street about ten minutes from JR Namba that stays open through the afternoon. The order is the chicken katsu curry (¥980): the katsu is the surprise, crisp outside and tender and juicy within, over a mild, homestyle European curry sweet with onion. Some diners find the sauce a little sparse for the rice; there's a spicier curry too. It can be slow when one person is cooking at the lunch rush, smoking is allowed and the room gets hot in summer. Closed Sundays.

anecdotes.text: "While the curry sauce itself wasn't particularly unique, the surprise came from the chicken katsu. The exterior was crispy, and the meat was tender, providing an excellent bite." — April 2026, Chicken Katsu Curry ¥980.
"The curry sauce is primarily sweet from the onions, with a very mild spiciness." — September 2026.

osaka_niku_teria_carne_bacca_kitahorie.gf_detail: Not gluten-free: pasta; baguette; hamburg steak; sauces.
osaka_niku_teria_carne_bacca_kitahorie.vegan_detail: Not vegan: a meat bar; butter rice; the shungiku salad may be meat-free — ask.
osaka_niku_teria_carne_bacca_kitahorie.hours_raw: Mon, Tue, Thu–Sun and public holidays 17:00–24:00 (last order 23:00); closed Wed (Tabelog). All-you-can-drink courses, e.g. 2 hours ¥5,500 (June 2026). Cards and QR (PayPay, d Barai, au PAY) accepted (Tabelog). Smoking allowed (Tabelog).
osaka_niku_teria_carne_bacca_kitahorie.notes: [Italian · a friendly Italian meat bar, Kitahorie] A stylish meat bar near Nishi-Ohashi that works for a solo glass at the counter or a group party at the tables. The signature is the slow-simmered beef tongue stew (¥2,600), tender enough to melt, with a baguette for the sauce; add the platter of chicken, pork and beef (¥2,280), the seared sirloin cap carpaccio and the homemade charcuterie, and finish with the butter rice topped with meat. Natto ajillo and a shungiku salad are unusual extras. Friendly staff; courses with two hours of drinks are ¥5,500. One diner found a group course thin and one had a Tabelog booking go unseen. Smoking allowed. Closed Wednesdays.

anecdotes.text: "The slowly simmered beef tongue is melt-in-your-mouth tender, and you'll want to add a baguette to soak up every drop of the sauce." — February 2026, Beef Tongue Stew ¥2,600.
"The standout dish was the Beef Sirloin Cap Carpaccio. It was a rare cut, seared over high heat…" — October 2026, all-you-can-drink course.

chef_bio.japanese_sources_summary: 食べログ: Niku Teria カルネバッカ、大阪市西区北堀江1-22-26、西大橋駅から徒歩2分、心斎橋・四ツ橋駅から5分、月・火・木〜日・祝 17:00〜24:00 (L.O. 23:00)、水曜休み、カード・QR (PayPay、d払い、au PAY) 可、喫煙可、20席 (カウンター6、テーブル14)。口コミ(2026年2〜10月): イタリアンの肉バル、前菜の盛り合わせ1,500円 (かぼちゃとさつまいものサラダ、ポテトサラダ、ハム)、自家製シャルキュトリ、鶏・豚・牛の肉の盛り合わせ2,280円、看板の牛タンのシチュー Hebereke 2,600円、sirloin cap のカルパッチョ、牛の tatakiのサラダ、shungiku のサラダ、natto のアヒージョ、ハンバーグ、Butcher's Bolognese、締めの肉のせバターライス、2時間飲み放題のコース5,500円、気さくな店の人、誕生日のプレートにも対応、団体のコースは物足りなかった・食べログの予約が確認されていなかったという声。
